result.summary: The page is mostly well-designed, but there are a couple of minor visual refinement issues regarding text truncation and placeholder elements.

issues.description: The restaurant title 'Trattoria Piccol' is abruptly truncated without an ellipsis at the edge of the card.
issues.suggestion: Implement CSS text-overflow: ellipsis to handle truncated text gracefully.

issues.description: The profile icon in the top right header appears as a blank white circle with a red dot, lacking a user avatar or placeholder icon.
issues.suggestion: Add a default user silhouette icon inside the circle to clarify its function.
